outcome: preterm birth at less than 37 weeks of gestation
preterm birth at less than 32 weeks of gestation
cohort: Women aged 18-45 years diagnosed with stage I-III breast cancer during 2000-2012 in California
finding: Breast cancer diagnosed at least one year before fertilization was not strongly associated with obstetric and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Women with a history of breast cancer had higher odds of undergoing cesarean delivery compared to matched controls.
